stage.name: Unopened Wisdom Pouch
stage.description:
The withered strategist disappears into the dark, snowy night. You open his last wisdom pouch, and find another cold, deadly plot. But perhaps it is a warm blessing as well, in its own way.
<Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally
<Writing knife> Can be used to move words
<Glyph Tile> Periodically drops Stamps, dealing True damage to both allies and enemies, and triggering any corresponding word effects

wield_arms.name: Wield Arms
wield_arms.flavourText: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Soldier'. The histories write: 'Upon the peaks was the beast cornered and killed.' It was the battlefield where the Feranmut was hunted, and where countless soldiers were buried. The smoke dissipates and the broken armor sinks into the sand, as the bleached bones hope to return in spring.
abilities: Vanishes when encountering another type of enemy, granting the target a portion of this unit's ATK, DEF, and RES, stacking up to 3 times per unit

wield_arms_oppress.name: Wield Arms - Oppress
wield_arms_oppress.flavourText: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Soldier'. The histories write: 'Upon the peaks was the beast cornered and killed.' It was the battlefield where the Feranmut was hunted, and where countless soldiers were buried. Swords and spears lie buried, and tears of blood have stopped flowing. The bleached bones shall know spring no more.
abilities: Vanishes when encountering another type of enemy, granting the target a portion of this unit's ATK, DEF, and RES, stacking up to 3 times per unit

draw_bow.name: Draw Bow
draw_bow.flavourText: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Bow. The histories write: 'Where does the bowstring return, across thousands of miles to the Pass?' Every goodbye on that bridge was solemn and earnest. The wind stirs the sand, the long bow a full moon; listen to the string ring, and hope for its bearer's return.
abilities: Hits 3 times
Prioritizes attacking allies on Glyph Tiles

draw_bow_screech.name: Draw Bow - Screech
draw_bow_screech.flavourText: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Bow'. The histories write: 'Where does the bowstring return, across thousands of miles to the Pass?' Every goodbye on that bridge was solemn and earnest. The sandstorm rages, and the bowstring wails, yet its bearer is nowhere to be seen, but for the lingering echoes of the string's ring.
abilities: Hits 3 times
Prioritizes attacking allies on Glyph Tiles

uproot_mountain.name: Uproot Mountain
uproot_mountain.flavourText: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Strength'. The histories write: 'Cold wind howls, for the brave never returned.' Their names are forgotten to history, but their legacies remain in a nation secure. So long as their strength holds, the way home shall be found.
abilities: Damage from Stamp reduced
When on a Glyph Tile, disables stamp effects for all glyphs on current tile and all connected Glyph Tiles

ribbon_in_the_waves_rust.name: Ribbon in the Waves - Rust
ribbon_in_the_waves_rust.flavourText: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Falsehood'. 'He who claims himself pure should be cast into murky waters.' Purity and corruption, truth and falsehood, are never easy to tell. Who can tell if the words of the swimming fins are true?
abilities: Can move through empty Glyph Tiles
Exits glyph form when stamped by a Stamp, becoming stunned, and cannot turn back to glyph form for a while
Cannot be teleported

raise_tide_summon.name: Raise Tide - Summon
raise_tide_summon.flavourText: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Brush'. At the end of the history book is a comment in dried ink: 'Spring and autumn are not me. How could they know how long the night is?' If history can be altered, and writing forged, who will seek justice for the innumerable souls lost to the ages?
abilities: Writes the glyph Soldier when first entering an empty Glyph Tile

thief_in_the_clouds_erode.name: Thief in the Clouds - Erode
thief_in_the_clouds_erode.flavourText: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Thief'. At the end of the history book is a comment in dried colored ink: 'The thief stole the ink, and sundered spring and autumn.' The writer's brush stops. How could one brush hope to stand against oblivion itself?
abilities: Flying unit.
Steals the first glyph encountered after a delay, losing Movement Speed

thief_in_the_clouds.name: Thief in the Clouds
thief_in_the_clouds.flavourText: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Thief'. At the end of the history book is a comment in light-colored ink: 'The thief stole the ink, and sundered spring and autumn.' The writer understands it well. It is not easy to write with honesty and integrity, but history will never be forgotten, so long as those who write continue to do so.
abilities: Flying unit.
Steals the first glyph encountered after a delay, losing Movement Speed

uproot_mountain_overshadow.name: Uproot Mountain - Overshadow
uproot_mountain_overshadow.flavourText: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Strength'. The histories write: 'Cold wind howls, for the brave never returned.' Their names are forgotten to history, and the nation is not yet secure. Even as their strength holds, they shall never find their way home.
abilities: Damage from Stamp reduced
When on a Glyph Tile, disables stamp effects for all glyphs on current tile and all connected Glyph Tiles

ribbon_in_the_waves.name: Ribbon in the Waves
ribbon_in_the_waves.flavourText: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Falsehood'. 'He who claims himself pure should be cast into murky waters.' Purity and corruption, truth and falsehood, are never decided by the fins swimming in the river.
abilities: Can move through empty Glyph Tiles
Exits glyph form when stamped by a Stamp, becoming stunned, and cannot turn back to glyph form for a while
Cannot be teleported
